lead_raw_text:
The structure of ThBiO₃ crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4₂/mnm (No. 119), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms—2 Th, 2 Bi, and 6 O—distributed over 3 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies octahedral coordination for all three elements: Bi and Th each have six O neighbors, while each O center has two Bi and four Th neighbors. The resulting periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals edge-sharing between O octahedra and between Bi and Th octahedra.
